items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: "Make Believe Ballroom," 1949, directed by Joseph Sandley.

ctx.x: Yeah. The merger came way later. "Make Believe Ballroom," 1949, directed by Joseph Sandley. Routine musical but rich in jazz appearances. Jimmy Dorsey and His Orchestra. Pee Wee Hunt and His Band. Charlie Barnet and His Band. Gene Krupa and His Band. And the King Cole Trio.
Well, I remember the picture, but I can't remember anything about it.
